name: image-cropper
title: Image Cropper
description: UI SDK ImageCropper styled: a selection that dims the rest of the image with a grid while dragging and eight handles, or a round frame the image pans and zooms under, with zoom, rotate and flip, and cropImage.
docs: `<ImageCropper aria-label src alt aspectRatio mode shape maxZoom crop onCropChange onCropCommit>`: with no children it renders the viewport (the image's ratio, or a square frame), the image, a selection that dims the rest through a spread `--overlay` shadow, shows a grid at the thirds while dragging and has eight handles (none in `mode="frame"`), then a zoom slider and Rotate, Flip horizontally and Flip vertically buttons with icons and their names from `labels`. Rotate and flip show their label because they're disabled until the image loads, when a tooltip couldn't show. `cropImage(src, crop, { width, shape })` (re-exported) makes the file; save in `onCropCommit`. In UI SDK 0.1.0-beta.10 the handles sit inside the selection's slider, which axe reports as nested-interactive; a frame has no handles.
